subject_group: 10.1.5 Aerial refueling sensing, data, visual cues, and lighting systems compatibility

versions.text:
Standard: All exterior lights and markings used during the AR process withstand exposure to expected environmental conditions and fluid exposures (e.g., fuel, hydraulic fluid, air vehicle cleaning solvents) without degradation in performance or appearance that creates a hazard to air vehicle or personnel. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of system specification verifies AR lighting and markings withstand exposure to expected environmental conditions and fluid exposures. Analysis.
  (1) Analysis of materials ensures lighting and markings are compatible with aviation environments and fluids, including but not limited to rain, salt fog, sand and dust, fungus, jet fuel, hydraulic fluid, isopropyl alcohol, and de-icing fluid. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Component qualification testing verifies lighting and markings utilized for AR can withstand expected environmental conditions and fluid exposure. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (2) Flight test: Flight test results show no incidents of degradation of lighting or marking visibility or interpretability due to environment or fluid exposure.
